name: project-leader
description: Autonomous project-control entry point with standing authority, architecture-first generic project bootstrap, immutable evidence, and bounded recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomously coordinates project work through audited role hierarchy and recovery.
interface.longDescription: Use Project Leader as a reusable control skill inside any software project. It identifies the active target repository without a central registry, reconstructs live GitHub and project architecture, routes work through Consultant, Supervisor, Builder, and Recovery Guardian, executes covered transitions under standing authority, audits durable evidence, and interrupts the Owner only for genuine manual intervention or a new uncovered material decision.
